name: Glyphs
description: People animating Sanctum's walls who distributed medallions and sought to resurrect Averru.

timeline.summary: Armies converge on Sanctum; Akroma's forces are admitted by the Glyphs, which twist her soldiers' loyalty to Lowallyn.
timeline.quote: Akroma , leading the forces of Topos , was granted entrance to the city by the strange Glyph people

timeline.summary: Phage's reanimated Cabal army is admitted; the Krosans led by Stonebrow and Kamahl smash their way in against the Glyphs.
timeline.quote: smashing the Glyphs as they galloped to the center of the struggle
